Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to recognize that the WebSurfer was stuck in a loop of retrieving the same search results (DuckDuckGo snippets) without successfully accessing the specific authoritative URLs (Wikipedia, IMDb, Korean Film Biz Zone) requested. Instead of adapting the strategy or acknowledging the retrieval failure, the Planner repeatedly issued identical or near-identical instructions to the WebSurfer to "open and extract" from these sources. This lack of verification and failure to pivot when the agent could not load the dynamic content led to redundant steps and an inefficient workflow, ultimately relying on incomplete data to finalize the answer.
